def find(fr,color):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return out
print('start: step',current_frame.step,'P',find(current_frame,'b'),'R',find(current_frame,'R'))
seq=['DOWN','UP','DOWN','UP','DOWN','UP']
for a in seq:
    action([a],intent='explore')
    fr=current_frame
    print(a,'step',fr.step,'P',find(fr,'b'),'R',find(fr,'R'),'go',last_action_result.get('game_over'),'ni',last_action_result.get('no_impact'))
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('no_impact'):
        print('STOPPED'); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
